title: Episode About the Creation the Khalsa Panth

blocks.text: The newly initiated Khalsa is instructed to erase divisions of caste and old religious rank, to live under one visible code, and to leave behind alliances with sectarian intermediaries and rival claimants. (12–15)
The discipline expands into daily conduct: kachh, turban, bani, repeated remembrance, and readiness in arms become part of the same shared bowl and one discipline. (14–17)
Food, hunting, bodily conduct, and attachment to older rites are all reworked so that the first initiates receive a distinct collective rule from the Guru himself. (18–20)
